It publishes the finest peer-reviewed research in all fields of science and technology on the basis of its originality, importance, interdisciplinary interest, timeliness, accessibility, elegance and surprising conclusions. Nature publishes landmark papers, award winning news, leading comment and expert opinion on important, topical scientific news and events that enable readers to share the latest discoveries in science and evolve the discussion amongst the global scientific community.

item.title: [8] Two-component exciton condensates in an electron–hole bilayer
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Allan H. MacDonald, Feng Wang

Authors: Ruishi Qi, Qize Li, Jiahui Nie, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Experimental study of exciton condensates in van der Waals heterostructures, with quantum coherence.

Tags: #excitoncondensate #vanderWaalsheterostructure #MoSe2 #WSe2 #quantumphasetransition #magnetism #stronglycorrelatedelectronsystems

Abstract: Nature, Published online: 10 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10636-y Macroscopic quantum coherence arises in two-component exciton Bose–Einstein condensates within MoSe2/hBN/WSe2 electron–hole bilayers, exhibiting distinct spin–valley polarized phases, quantum phase transitions under magnetic fields and stable condensate behaviour up to approximately 1.8 K.

item.title: [7] Light-induced quantum friction of carbon nanotubes in water
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Marialore Sulpizi, Sebastian Kruss

Authors: Tanuja Kistwal, Krishan Kanhaiya, Adrian Buchmann, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Experimental study of light-induced quantum friction and exciton interactions in carbon nanotubes.

Tags: #carbonnanotube #quantumfriction #excitons #nanomaterials #light-matterinteraction

Abstract: Nature, Published online: 10 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10632-2 Near-infrared fluorescent carbon nanotubes exhibit light-induced quantum friction in water, in which exciton interactions slow nanoscale motion and enable optical control of diffusion and fluid dynamics.
